components.name: Run Card

components.css: .ds-card{width:360px;display:grid;gap:16px;padding:22px;border:1px solid var(--hairline-strong,rgba(255,255,255,0.15));border-radius:22px;background:linear-gradient(165deg,var(--card-top,#1f1e1c),var(--card-bottom,#121211));color:var(--text,#ece8e1);font-family:var(--font-serif, Literata, Georgia, serif)}.ds-stamp{color:var(--muted,#a39e96);font:12px/1.3 var(--font-mono, "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace);letter-spacing:0.04em}.ds-art{aspect-ratio:16/9;border-radius:12px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--rhythm-hit,#8fd18a) 0 4px,transparent 4px 8px) bottom/100% 60% no-repeat,var(--ground,#0f0f0e)}.ds-score{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px}.ds-score strong{font-size:132px;font-weight:300;line-height:0.9;letter-spacing:-0.04em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums lining-nums}.ds-score span{color:var(--muted,#a39e96);font:12px/1.2 var(--font-mono, "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace)}.ds-facts{margin:0;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--hairline,rgba(255,255,255,0.075));display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px}.ds-facts dt{color:var(--muted,#a39e96);font:12px/1.3 var(--font-mono, "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace)}.ds-facts dd{margin:0;font-size:24px;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-0.02em}

narrative.overview:
The typing passage is the screen. Everything readable is set in one book face, Literata, on a warm near-black ground (or warm paper in light), so a passage reads like a page and a result reads like a print rather than a dashboard. One green carries every meaning of "act here" or "you are here": the caret, the primary button, the current selection and the timer. Content sits on hairline rules and open space. Boxes are kept for the few things that really are objects: the floating dock, the settings popover, the command palette, dialogs, toasts, and the run card.

Motion is governed by "still run". While a run is in progress, nothing decorative moves near the passage. The caret is a solid spring-driven bar, letter states change instantly, lines scroll in about 150 ms, and the chrome fades out after the first keystroke. Motion belongs to chrome and to the time after a run: short fades, one gliding selection pill, and the run card's dithered rhythm art developing once in about 450 ms. Every duration comes from one scale that drops to zero under reduced motion.

Density is low and deliberate. The practice screen centres the passage with the numbers above it and a small set of controls. Results, progress and challenge are single editorial columns separated by rules. The name "Stilltype" is a working title, so the wordmark stays a cheap italic word plus a green full stop.
keyCharacteristics: Literata for everything readable, including the passage and every numeral; Geist Mono only for small measurement labels, conditions and keys.
Dark (default) and light theme sets; the theme follows the system until the user picks one.
One green accent; coral for mistyped letters and regressions; amber for interrupted and mixed results.
Rules and space instead of boxes; opaque raised surfaces with a single soft float shadow; no glass, no glow.
Still run: the passage area stays motionless apart from the caret and line scroll.
Results are a static print: a run card with dithered rhythm art drawn from real keystroke intervals.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Green means "act here" or "you are here" and nothing else. There is exactly one filled-green control per view: the primary button. Secondary controls get a neutral focus ring, so they never read as a second primary.

rules.name: The Two-Cue Rule
rules.body: Coral never carries meaning alone. A mistyped letter is coral text, a coral tint behind it, and a wavy underline.

rules.name: The Tokens-Only Rule
rules.body: Every colour comes from a CSS variable defined in both theme blocks. Add a token to both themes before using a new value.

rules.name: The Book-Face Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every metric is set in Literata with tabular lining figures (`.num`). Geist Mono sets only the unit or label beside it, never the number.

rules.name: The Measuring Mono Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono appears at 12–13px for labels, conditions and keys. It is never used for headings, body copy or buttons.

rules.name: The Lowercase Chrome Rule
rules.body: Chrome labels (dock, settings, palette, mono labels) are lowercase. Headings and buttons use sentence case. Nothing is uppercase.

rules.name: The Rules-Not-Boxes Rule
rules.body: Sections are separated by a 1px hairline and space, never by a card. If a region is not a floating object or the run card, it has no background and no border box.

rules.name: The Step-Back Rule
rules.body: While a run is in progress (`body[data-running="true"]`), the dock, controls, shortcuts and footer fade to zero opacity and stop taking pointer input unless they hold focus. Only the passage and the numbers remain.

rules.name: The Opaque Float Rule
rules.body: A surface that floats is opaque raised stock plus the float shadow. It has no glass, no blur behind it and no coloured glow.

dos: Do take every colour, size, radius, duration and easing from the CSS variables at the top of `src/styles.css`, and define new colour tokens in both the dark and light blocks.
Do set every readable word and every number in Literata, with tabular lining figures on metrics. Keep Geist Mono to 12–13px labels, conditions and keys.
Do keep exactly one filled-green primary action per view. All other actions are secondary, ghost or danger.
Do separate sections with a 1px hairline and 32px of space.
Do pair coral with a second cue: a wavy underline, a tint, or a word.

Do drive every duration from the `--dur-*` scale (80, 150, 200, 250, 350ms × `--motion-scale`) with the `--ease-out` curve (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`), so reduced motion takes them all to zero.
Do keep chrome fades at 200ms or less, and animate the selection pill by transform only.
Do keep chrome labels lowercase and headings and buttons in sentence case.
donts: Don't move anything decorative near the passage while a run is in progress. Letter states change instantly; only the caret spring and the ~150ms line scroll move.

Don't reintroduce the effects removed after the critique: a streak glow or caret aura, a letter ink trail (letters landing lit and cooling), an error shake, digit pop-ins or number reels, a word underline or lens sweeping through the glyphs, run-card tilt, glare or foil, glass surfaces, a live rhythm strip, or blur reveals on restart and results.

Don't use backdrop-filter, translucent surfaces or coloured glows. Floating surfaces are opaque raised stock with the one float shadow. (The challenge handoff's blurred passage veil is a concealment device that hides the next player's text. It is not a reveal effect and must not spread elsewhere.)
Don't add kickers or eyebrows above headings, and don't use uppercase tracked labels.
Don't add a second accent. Periwinkle belongs to the ghost pacer alone, and amber to interrupted and mixed results alone.
Don't box ordinary sections as cards. The run card is the one card.
Don't move the app back toward the retired Ash system: no blue call to action, no Geist sans, no dark-only rule, no mono status pills.
Don't invest in the wordmark. "Stilltype" is a working title, and the brand stays an italic word and a green full stop.
